Arithmetic Progressions chapter overview for Class 10 Maths: what an AP is, the nth term, the sum of n terms, and the three traps that cost marks.

• What an AP is, and how to find the common difference d (later term minus earlier term)
• The nth term: a_n = a + (n − 1)d, with NCERT examples worked step by step
• The sum of the first n terms: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n − 1)d], and where it comes from (the Gauss trick)
• Three common mistakes, and a rapid revision at the end
